plugins.name: multi-model-bridge
plugins.description: Multi-model collaboration for ZCode: when the active model lacks a capability (image/vision understanding, now), delegate the subtask to an external model and fold its result into your reasoning.

description_i18n.en: Multi-model collaboration for ZCode: when the active model lacks a capability (image/vision understanding, now), delegate the subtask to an external model and fold its result into your reasoning.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode 多模型协同：当当前模型缺失某项能力（现在为图像/视觉理解）时，把子任务路由给外部模型处理，并把结果整合进推理。
